title: Participant geographies data — Middle layer super output areas (MSOA)
description: Middle Layer Super Output Areas (MSOA) for England and Wales.

PID.title: Participant ID
PID.$comment: Many-to-one link to participant.PID; that every PID exists there cannot be enforced across tables (D090). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

ID.title: Row ID
ID.$comment: Local primary key: unique within this table (D090). The source states no format, so no pattern is asserted (D043).

MSOA_AT_REG.title: Middle Super Output Area (MSOA) of participants living in England and Wales at the time of registration
MSOA_AT_REG.$comment: Format taken from the source's own 7264 codes, all of which match it; whether a code is one of them is not checked, because listing them would make the page and the schema unusably large (D098).
